meta.purpose: PRIMARY: fetch flashy showpiece animated components LIVE from code libraries at build time, based on the user's prompt. FALLBACK: a curated map of plain components. Inspiration galleries are VISUAL REFERENCE ONLY (no code).
rules: Match the user's described effect to a showpiece entry OR search the code_libraries live.
Fetch live via the entry's registry command (preferred) or WebFetch/Playwright the component page (fallback).
NEVER paste raw: adapt colors to brand tokens, respect prefers-reduced-motion, install the right deps. See references/adaptation.md + references/live-fetch.md.
galleries[] have NO code. Use only for visual direction. Never try to fetch components from them.
After placing, hand off final polish to the impeccable / frontend-design skills.
Before picking or composing a layouts[] entry, read TASTE.md's curation criteria (web or video section as applicable).

known_issues.why: Vercel Attack Challenge Mode returns HTTP 429 to every non-browser client. The registry is healthy; a real browser fetches valid JSON. Use the Playwright method. See references/live-fetch.md.

registry_cli.how: Run the shadcn registry command, e.g. `npx shadcn@latest add "https://magicui.design/r/marquee.json"`. Most reliable; resolves deps + files automatically.
registry_cli.when: Library exposes a shadcn registry namespace (magicui, aceternity, cult-ui, etc.).
registry_cli.safety: Registry commands pull code into the project. Show the user the command before running. Prefer pinned/official namespaces; do not run arbitrary unknown-registry URLs without review.

webfetch.how: WebFetch the component's docs page, extract the code block, then write it into the project + install listed deps.
webfetch.when: No registry command available, or you only need to read the code.
webfetch.limit: Galleries + JS-heavy pages may not expose code cleanly to WebFetch.

registry_item.how: GET `fetch.url` (a shadcn registry-item JSON). Write each `files[].content` to its `target`, resolving a leading `$lib/` to `src/lib/` (SvelteKit's alias). Then install `dependencies[]` and the entry's `deps`.
registry_item.when: The registry's JSON is sound but no CLI places its files correctly. Today: every Svelte Bits variant. `npx shadcn` writes a literal `src/$lib/` dir, `npx shadcn-svelte` nests it under `src/lib/components/$lib/`, and `npx jsrepo` writes `./$lib/` at the project root (#66).
registry_item.safety: Same as registry_cli: this writes code into the project. Show the user the URL and the target paths before writing.

playwright.how: Use the playwright skill to open the page and read the rendered code panel / copy button content.
playwright.when: WebFetch misses code behind tabs/JS. Heavier; use only when needed.

code_libraries.name: reactbits
code_libraries.license: MIT + Commons Clause: commercial use is fine as part of a product; no reselling/redistributing the components themselves
code_libraries.note: registry item names are PascalCase with a variant suffix: <Name>-{TS|JS}-{TW|CSS}, e.g. SplitText-TS-TW. Invalid names return the site's HTML shell with HTTP 200, so verify the response is registry-item JSON, not just the status code.

code_libraries.name: 21st.dev
code_libraries.registry: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/<author>/<name>" (registry endpoint now requires a 21st.dev account/API key; unauthenticated requests get {"error":"Authentication required"})
code_libraries.license: per-component (NO blanket license; every curated entry below carries its own verified license field)
code_libraries.best_for: huge community registry; search by effect.
code_libraries.note: Unauthenticated registry requests return HTTP 403 {"error":"Authentication required"}. Without an API key, fetch via the public component page (webfetch/playwright method), or use the entry's registry_alt when the author mirrors the component on their own open registry. API-key path (opt-in, needs shadcn CLI 3.0+ namespaced registries): see references/live-fetch.md § 1b.
code_libraries.mirror_note: Most curated 21st.dev entries actually resolve through kokonutui.com, the author's own open registry. That host carries real traffic for this skill, so it is health-checked independently of 21st.dev itself.

code_libraries.name: vue-bits
code_libraries.license: MIT + Commons Clause: commercial use is fine as part of a product; no reselling/redistributing the components themselves
code_libraries.best_for: Vue port of ReactBits (same author, David Haz; official, declared parity with the React originals)
code_libraries.note: Framework-variant source only: referenced from a showpiece entry's frameworks.vue, not from a top-level showpiece.library. Registry item names are PascalCase, 1:1 with the ReactBits name (e.g. SplitText.json), and are plain shadcn registry-item JSON (public/r/<Name>.json), so the same npx <cli>@latest add "<url>" shape as every other library works, just through shadcn-vue instead of shadcn.

code_libraries.name: svelte-bits
code_libraries.registry: fetch registry item "https://sveltebits.xyz/r/<name>.json", write each files[].content to its target with $lib/ as src/lib/ (fetch method registry_item, see #66)
code_libraries.license: MIT + Commons Clause: commercial use is fine as part of a product; no reselling/redistributing the components themselves
deps: varies per component, e.g. gsap, ogl, three
code_libraries.best_for: Svelte port of ReactBits (same author, David Haz; official, states parity with the React originals including dependencies, shaders, and physics)
code_libraries.note: Framework-variant source only: referenced from a showpiece entry's frameworks.svelte, not from a top-level showpiece.library. Item names are lowercase-kebab, NOT the PascalCase ReactBits/Vue Bits spelling (aurora.json, not Aurora.json), and carry no -TS-TW suffix. Wrong-case names return the site's HTML shell with HTTP 200, so verify the response is registry-item JSON. No CLI places its $lib/-rooted targets correctly (shadcn, shadcn-svelte, and jsrepo all misplace them), so variants use fetch method registry_item.

code_libraries.name: inspira-ui
code_libraries.license: MIT (unovue/inspira-ui). Ports Aceternity UI and Magic UI designs to Vue; the project's README states Aceternity gave permission to adapt the original designs. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
deps: @inspira-ui/plugins for the cn() helper (needed by nearly every component and NOT declared in the registry item)
varies per component, e.g. cobe, simplex-noise
code_libraries.best_for: Vue variants of the Aceternity and Magic UI showpieces
code_libraries.note: Framework-variant source only: referenced from a showpiece entry's frameworks.vue, not from a top-level showpiece.library. Item names are lowercase-kebab and do NOT always match the React original (aceternity 3d-card -> card-3d, lamp -> lamp-effect, magicui particles -> particles-bg, animated-shiny-text -> radiant-text), so map per entry rather than by pattern. inspira-ui.com/r/<name>.json 307-redirects to registry.inspira-ui.com; follow redirects. Every variant's deps below add @inspira-ui/plugins where the source imports it, because the registry item's own dependencies array omits it.
